Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking a Associate Systems / Systems Engineer (T01/T02) for Post Flight Analysis within Modeling, Simulation, and Analysis (MS&A). This position is located in Roy, UT and supports the Sentinel program.

What You’ll Get To Do:

As a Post Flight Analysis Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining analysis tools and conducting post flight analysis. Candidates should be knowledgeable in one or more of the following areas: optical data processing, radar metric and signature processing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics, aerodynamics, statistical mathematics, flight control, and guidance and navigation. A successful candidate would be familiar with one or more of the following scripting/programming languages: MATLAB, Fortran, and C++.

Specific duties to include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Metric and signature radar processing for a flight test vehicle

  • Optical data processing for a flight test vehicle

  • Modify existing post-flight analysis tools written in MATLAB and C++

  • Develop modernized tools based on legacy Fortran tools

  • Flight test data analysis to include Best Estimate of Trajectory generation, GPS signal processing and refinement, and RV accuracy analysis

  • System performance assessment, requirements analysis, verification and validation, design, development, and integration

  • Create technical reports and present analysis results

  • Interface with internal and external customers

  • Participation in a collaborative Agile environment

Basic Qualifications:

This requisition may be filled at either the Associate Systems Engineer level (T01) or Systems Engineer level (T02).

Associate Systems Engineer (T01):

  • Bachelor of Science degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline from an accredited university and 1 years of experience, 0 years of experience with a Master of Science degree

Systems Engineer (T02):

  • Bachelor of Science degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) discipline and 2 years of related experience; 0 years of experience with a Master of Science degree

Requirements for both levels:

  • Must be a US Citizen with an active U.S. Government Secret Clearance, at time of application, current and within scope, with an investigation date within the last 6 years

  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) approval within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business need

  • Experience with one or more of the following languages: C++, Fortran, MATLAB

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret Clearance

  • Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering

  • Experience in modeling, simulation, and analysis

  • Experience with radar processing

  • Experience with one or more of the following knowledge areas: ICBM flight dynamics, targeting, orbital mechanics, reentry dynamics, Object Oriented Programing (OOP)

  • Experience with version control management software similar to Git

  • Experience with software documentation development, testing (unit or functional), or Verification & Validation (V&V)

  • Demonstrated expertise soliciting input from internal and external stakeholders, synthesizing data, and communicating complex results to technical and non-technical stakeholders at various levels

  • Advanced use of standard Microsoft Office products to include development tools
